text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First day of summer training camp. Daitaku 
Helios gets hyped up calling her besties. 
Fired up to the max, she vows to become 
crazy strong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Mejiro Palmer offer her support 
makes your heart skip a beat. Together 
4-ever, you sprint through your Aoharu 
youth.
